> **Reconstruction note:** This file reconstructs the accepted #1300 scope findings after orchestration context compaction. It preserves the investigated decisions and contracts, but is not a byte-for-byte copy of the earlier scoping response.

Build one global Metrics Explorer for the time-series metrics django-mojo actually records: choose an authorized account, discover categories and full slugs, chart at a valid range/granularity, compare KPI deltas, and fan out one group metric across a child kind. Known scalar values may be entered explicitly, but gauge browsing is deferred because the current gauge key encoding/index cannot provide exact universal discovery. Do not expose arbitrary REST-model aggregation as if it were metrics discovery.

The filed premise that the explorer needs "zero new endpoints" is false. django-mojo exposes category discovery only after the caller supplies an account. Full browsing therefore depends on django-mojo #1438, **Metrics: permission-safe discovery endpoint for portal explorer**. Land and verify #1438 first, then build #1300 as one coherent feature; a mock-only or “Tier 1” partial delivery is not completion evidence.

## Spec

- **Kind:** feature
- **Parent:** #1260 "Admin program"
- **Surface:** an additive route in the existing reusable global `MONITORING_ADMIN_SECTION`
- **Route:** `/metrics/explorer` (and `/system/metrics/explorer` when the Admin section is embedded)
- **Dependencies:** #1258 chart primitives, #1275 Admin shell conventions, #1285 Monitoring section, and blocking django-mojo #1438 for full discovery
- **Authoritative sources:**
  - `django-mojo/mojo/apps/metrics/rest/{base,categories,values,helpers,permissions}.py`
  - `django-mojo/mojo/apps/metrics/redis_metrics.py`
  - `portal-mojo/src/charts/{MetricsChart,MetricsMiniWidget,KPIStrip}.tsx`
  - `portal-mojo/src/client/client.ts`
  - `portal-mojo/src/admin/monitoring/{index,models}.ts`

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The existing Monitoring section contributes a system-pinned Metrics Explorer route guarded by the exact global read clause `sys.view_metrics | sys.metrics`; it does not treat a tenant/member grant as permission to mount the global Admin route.
- [ ] The explorer can chart an explicitly supplied `public`, `global`, `group-<id>`, `user-<id>`, or opaque custom account and browse #1438-authorized accounts/categories/slugs. Every lookup/fetch remains backend-authoritative; denial is an error, never an empty authorized account.
- [ ] Time-series requests use `dt_start` / `dt_end`, not the stale `dr_start` / `dr_end` names. Epoch seconds remain the portal convention accepted by django-mojo's typed datetime parser.
- [ ] Full colon-bearing slugs are the client identity everywhere. History responses that use the backend's truncated tail keys are remapped only from the requested full-slug set; duplicate tails are split into safe single-slug requests rather than silently colliding.
- [ ] KPI point/delta data from `/api/metrics/series?with_delta=true` retains full slug keys, including colons. Scalar `/api/metrics/value/get` requests are made one full slug at a time because that endpoint truncates response keys.
- [ ] Group fan-out requires `account=group-<parent-id>` and an explicit `child_kind`. Sum mode supports selected slugs; breakdown mode is single-slug only and treats returned child labels plus `groups` as series identity, not as metric slugs.
- [ ] Consume exact #1438 `GET /api/metrics/discover?resource=accounts|categories|slugs` via a typed `mojoCall` adapter preserving `count`, `page_count`, and `next_start`; never coerce it through `mojoList`, use `/permissions` as an oracle, or fabricate data-only/gauge discovery.
- [ ] Known scalar slugs may be read one at a time and shown as raw values with optional presentation-only scale. Gauge browsing/health semantics are not claimed.
- [ ] Directory pickers mount only with their exact global Group/User view clauses; otherwise bounded opaque account entry remains available and emits no lookup request.
- [ ] CSV export neutralizes spreadsheet formula prefixes in the shared chart encoder before RFC-compatible quoting.
- [ ] Generic REST-model `_mode=count|top|distinct|summary|histogram` aggregation is explicitly deferred. It uses a different `dr_*` query grammar and each arbitrary model's own permission/field contract; it is not a safe generic metrics source.
- [ ] Mock/live envelopes, permission failures, colon slugs, discovery pagination, fan-out, KPI deltas, and gauges have focused verification; portal and showcase build; the demo is inspected in light/dark and narrow layouts with a clean console.

## Premise corrections

### Discovery is a backend dependency

Current REST supports:

- `GET /api/metrics/categories?account=<account>` — permission-checked after the account is supplied.
- `GET /api/metrics/category_slugs?account=<account>&category=<category>` — likewise account-scoped and permission-checked.
- `GET /api/metrics/permissions` — lists only configured permission accounts and is restricted to global `manage_incidents | metrics | manage_metrics`; it is an administration endpoint, not view-safe discovery.

Current Python-only helpers do not provide a safe portal contract. #1438 adds exact time-series discovery at `GET /api/metrics/discover?resource=accounts|categories|slugs`, with optional `account`, exact `category`, case-insensitive substring `search`, bounded `start`/`size`, and `{data,start,size,count,page_count,next_start,filters}`. Account catalog enumeration is global-Admin/authenticated; every candidate still passes live account policy, and scoped registry reads authorize before touching hidden data. Gauge discovery is deliberately absent because its current key encoding is non-injective and it has no maintained index. #1300 must not simulate any missing contract client-side.

### Metrics history uses `dt_*`, not `dr_*`

`/api/metrics/fetch` reads `dt_start` and `dt_end`. The shipped `MetricsChart`, `MetricsMiniWidget`, `KPIStrip`, and date helpers already send those names correctly. `dr_start` / `dr_end` belongs to the separate generic model aggregation protocol; sending it to metrics history is silently ignored. #1300 documents and verifies `dt_*` without regressing the existing chart client.

### Colon slugs are valid and history keys are lossy

Metrics such as `auth:failures` and `sl:click:Xk9mR2p` are valid full slugs. `metrics.fetch()` and fan-out sum currently key history datasets by `slug.split(':')[-1]`, and `/value/get` does the same. Thus `foo:count` and `bar:count` overwrite each other in one response. In contrast, `/series`/`fetch_values()` preserves full keys in `data`, `prev_data`, and `deltas`.

The client boundary must use the request as the source of identity:

1. Parse and de-duplicate requested full slugs without normalizing colons.
2. For ordinary history or fan-out sum, batch slugs whose tails are unique, map each returned tail back to its one full requested slug, and request each duplicate-tail slug separately before reassembling datasets in request order.
3. Reject a response that cannot be mapped unambiguously; do not guess by object order.
4. For fan-out breakdown, require one full slug and retain returned child labels/`groups` as the dataset identity.
5. For scalar values, issue one request per full gauge slug and store the result under that requested full slug.

This belongs in an explorer metrics adapter, or in a narrowly tested exact-identity addition to the shared client. It must not change display labels into wire identity.

## Exact permission gates

- **Explorer Admin route:** `METRICS_EXPLORER_PERMISSIONS = ['sys.view_metrics', 'sys.metrics']`, matching global-account `check_view_permissions`. `sys.manage_metrics` alone is not added as an invented read grant.
- **Metrics Permissions route:** retain `METRICS_PERMISSIONS_ADMIN_PERMISSIONS = ['sys.manage_incidents', 'sys.metrics', 'sys.manage_metrics']`, exactly matching `/api/metrics/permissions`. Do not reuse this manage clause for the explorer.
- **Monitoring section:** its section permission array is the union of both route audiences; exact route clauses still apply. Verify `sys.view_metrics` = explorer only, `sys.metrics` = both, `sys.manage_metrics` = permissions editor only, and no global metric grant = neither.
- **Directory pickers:** Group lookup additionally requires `sys.view_groups|sys.manage_groups|sys.groups`; User lookup requires `sys.view_users|sys.manage_users|sys.users`. Without those grants render opaque account entry and issue no directory query.
- **`public` account:** reads are open at the endpoint, but the global Admin route remains system-pinned.
- **`global` account:** authenticated global `view_metrics | metrics`.
- **`group-<id>` account:** restricted identities must first satisfy the tenant bound. Then either the allowed global read clause applies or the user has group `view_metrics | metrics`; assumed-member sessions do not borrow the underlying user's global dictionary.
- **`user-<id>` account:** global read clause or the authenticated user's own id.
- **Custom account:** Redis-configured view permission; `public` is open, otherwise the authenticated caller must hold the configured global permission. Missing configuration denies.

Route visibility is only a coarse shell gate. Every account discovery, category lookup, history fetch, point fetch, and gauge read still goes to the backend and fails closed. An inaccessible item is never shown based on a client-side permission guess, and 403/permission failure is never normalized to an empty dataset.

## Plan

### Objective

Extend the existing Monitoring AdminSection with a generic-but-safe recorded-metrics explorer. Reuse the chart package, preserve exact full-slug identity, separate explicit-source functionality from discovery-dependent functionality, and keep arbitrary model aggregation out of the surface.

### Implementation — after django-mojo #1438 is Done

1. **Add typed metrics explorer contracts and pure identity adapters**
   - Extend `packages/portal-mojo/src/admin/monitoring/models.ts` or add `metrics-explorer-data.ts` and `metrics-explorer-client.ts` beside it.
   - Export `METRICS_EXPLORER_PERMISSIONS = ['sys.view_metrics','sys.metrics']` and typed `MetricAccount`, `MetricCategory`, `MetricSeriesSelection`, `MetricPoint`, `MetricDelta`, `MetricGaugeValue`, and fan-out response shapes.
   - Implement pure account parsing/formatting and full-slug de-duplication. Reserved `group-`/`user-` forms require positive integer ids and never fall back to custom interpretation; other custom account ids are opaque exact strings rejected only when empty, overlong, or containing controls.
   - Add a typed #1438 discovery client using `mojoCall`, not `mojoList`, for exact `resource`, `account`, `category`, `search`, `start`, and `size` params plus `count/page_count/next_start` semantics.
   - Add exact-identity adapters for `/fetch`, `/series`, and `/value/get`. Preserve full requested keys, split duplicate-tail history/value requests, preserve request order, and reject malformed/ambiguous responses.
   - Keep Query keys scoped by endpoint, full account, full slug list, range/granularity, and fan-out params. Never cache a permission denial as an empty success.

2. **Register the exact route gate in the existing section**
   - Modify `packages/portal-mojo/src/admin/monitoring/index.ts` to export `MetricsExplorerPage`, add `metrics/explorer`, and set the section permission array to the union of explorer and permissions-editor audiences while preserving exact per-route clauses.
   - Leave `metrics/permissions` on its existing manage clause. Do not create a second Monitoring section or a `:id` route.

3. **Build the explicit account/source picker**
   - Create `MetricsExplorerPage.tsx` and small controlled picker components under `admin/monitoring/`.
   - Default to `global` only for a system-pinned operator; browse #1438 account/category/slug pages and allow exact fallback entry. Mount Group/User CollectionSelect only under its separate directory grant; otherwise issue no lookup and keep bounded opaque account entry. The active app group never changes the account.
   - A lookup/fetch denial leaves the selection visible with a clear permission error and Retry/Change account actions. It does not fall through to public or another tenant.

4. **Add the exact-identity MetricsChart boundary and compose views**
   - Modify `MetricsChart` additively with typed optional `loadSeries(params:MetricsFetchParams):Promise<MetricsResponse>` defaulting to `mojoMetrics`; promote required breakdown/child options to typed props rather than raw URL passthrough. The explorer supplies its exact-identity adapter while existing callers retain default behavior and controls.
   - Add KPI tiles backed by one `/series?with_delta=true` request at an explicit `when` and granularity. Use full keys from `data`, `prev_data`, and `deltas`; absence of `delta_pct` when the previous value is zero is a valid state, not an error.
   - Offer fan-out only for a valid group account. Require `child_kind`; sum may chart multiple non-colliding/full-identity slugs through the safe adapter, while breakdown disables multi-select and preserves the backend's child label and `groups` mapping.
   - Avoid writes entirely. The explorer does not record metrics, set scalar values, edit permissions, or clear data.

5. **Ship live-shaped mock, docs, demo, and verifier**
   - Extend the mock with explicit public/global/group/user/custom accounts, categories, full colon slugs, full-key `/series` deltas, truncated `/fetch` and `/value/get` live parity, fan-out sum/breakdown, and exact permission denials.
   - Add exact #1438 discovery envelopes, authorization/no-oracle counts, pagination/search, and denials only after the backend lands. The mock `/fetch` reproduces live tail-key truncation/collisions; tests drive `dt_*` and the exact adapter rather than relying on its older `range` fallback.
   - Harden the shared chart CSV cell encoder in `stats.ts` against `=`, `+`, `-`, `@`, tab, and carriage-return formula prefixes before quoting; use it from existing chart export paths.
   - Add docs, showcase demo, token-only styles, verifier, navigation check, and build commands listed in the quality contract.

6. **Close permission, cache, and browser evidence**
   - Verify the exact route/editor/directory-picker permission matrix, including suppression of unauthorized picker requests and the fact that tenant membership never mounts the global route.
   - Verify visible-only discovery counts/pages, cache keys scoped by caller/account/filter/page, and that denied/failed requests never seed success cache or reuse another identity's results.
   - Inspect account/category/slug browsing, history, KPI delta, fan-out, and optional exact scalar entry in mock Portal/showcase at desktop/narrow widths, light/dark themes, keyboard navigation, and a clean console. Live smoke is read-only.

### Explicitly deferred: arbitrary model aggregation

Do not implement a UI that accepts arbitrary endpoints/fields and appends `_mode=count|top|distinct|summary|histogram`. That protocol uses `dr_start`/`dr_end`, model-specific field/operator semantics, and each model's REST permission/graph. Neither `/api/metrics/discover` nor the Admin route can authorize or describe it safely. If desired, file a separate schema-aware reporting-builder item with endpoint/field allowlisting and per-model tests; it is not part of #1300's recorded-metrics explorer.

## Schema / migrations

None. Portal state is transient UI/query state. #1438 is an additive REST route over existing Redis registries and permission helpers and requires no database or Redis schema migration.

## Caller / wire contract changes

- Additive Admin export/route: `MetricsExplorerPage`, `METRICS_EXPLORER_PERMISSIONS`, and mount-relative `metrics/explorer`.
- Additive portal client helpers for categories, category slugs, history, point/delta, scalar values, fan-out, and—after #1438—discovery.
- Potential hardening of `mojoMetrics`: returned dataset labels become the exact requested full slugs for ordinary history/fan-out sum. Breakdown child labels remain child labels. This is a correctness fix for colon-bearing slugs and needs focused existing-chart regression coverage.
- `/api/metrics/fetch` wire remains `dt_start`, `dt_end`, `granularity`, `account`, and `slug|slugs|category`; optional `child_kind`, `breakdown`, and `allow_empty` retain current backend semantics.
- `/api/metrics/series` remains `when`, `granularity`, `account`, `slug|slugs`, optional `with_delta=true`; its full-slug maps are consumed without truncation.
- `/api/metrics/value/get` remains read-only here and is called once per full gauge slug because its response map currently truncates.
- New dependency contract: `/api/metrics/discover?resource=accounts|categories|slugs&account=&category=&search=&start=&size=` returns sorted, permission-filtered full identifiers with total `count`, `page_count`, and `next_start`; the portal consumes it through typed `mojoCall`.

## Risks and mitigations

- **Discovery oracle:** account/series names can reveal tenant behavior. Only #1438 may enumerate; it filters every result server-side. The portal does not use `/permissions` or broad trial requests.
- **Colon collisions:** history/value endpoints truncate keys. The adapter derives identity from requested full slugs, splits duplicate tails, and fails ambiguous/malformed results.
- **Cross-tenant access:** a caller can type `group-2`. The backend tenant bound remains authoritative; the client never falls back after denial.
- **Permission-clause drift:** view and manage routes have different exact grants. Keep separate exported constants and verifier assertions.
- **Wrong date vocabulary:** verify metrics requests contain `dt_*` and do not contain `dr_*`; reserve `dr_*` for the deferred model aggregation protocol.
- **Fan-out cardinality:** django-mojo caps active children at `METRICS_FANOUT_MAX_CHILDREN` (default 200). Surface the server error; do not silently sample or retry child-by-child.
- **Breakdown identity:** child names can duplicate; preserve backend `name#id` keys and `groups` sidecar rather than humanizing away identity.
- **Delta edge:** `delta_pct` is absent when previous is zero. Render an absolute delta and unavailable percentage without Infinity.
- **Gauge meaning:** scalar storage has no injective universal discovery index or general thresholds/unit. Only exact manual scalar entry is available; any scale is presentation-only.
- **Mock optimism:** before #1438, the mock must not imply browse-all exists. Afterward, mirror permission filtering, paging, and full identifiers exactly.
- **Shared client regression:** if `mojoMetrics` is hardened globally, cover simple slugs, unique colon tails, duplicate tails, category fetch, fan-out sum, and fan-out breakdown before changing existing charts.

## Verification

- **Tier:** targeted
- **Run:** `npm run typecheck` (clean baseline before edits and at close); `npm run verify:admin-metrics-explorer`; `npm run verify:admin-navigation`; `npm run build -w portal`; `npm run build -w showcase`; `git diff --check`.
- **Bound:** additive Monitoring route, explorer adapters/components, metrics mock fixtures, docs/demo/styles, and at most one exact-identity correction at the shared metrics client boundary; no schema, dependency, mutation, generic model UI, or auth implementation changes.
- **Evidence:** tests, command, visual, manual.

### Focused verifier assertions

- Standalone/embedded paths and permission matrix: view-only explorer, metrics both routes, manage-only editor, neither; Group/User picker request suppression without directory grants; no active-group fallback.
- Account parser and permission-denial behavior for public/global/reserved group/user/opaque custom sources; canonical `URLSearchParams` state conveys no authority.
- `dt_start`/`dt_end` present and `dr_start`/`dr_end` absent on history requests.
- Exact full identity for simple slugs, one colon slug, unique colon tails, duplicate tails, missing series, and malformed ambiguous responses.
- `/series` full-key current/previous/delta parsing, including previous zero and absent `delta_pct`.
- Fan-out account/kind validation, multi-slug sum, single-slug breakdown, duplicate child names, and server cardinality error.
- Exact #1438 resource/envelope/paging/search/no-oracle/full identifiers through `mojoCall`; denied/failed requests never seed success cache or cross identity keys.
- Typed `MetricsChart.loadSeries` injection and regression of default callers.
- Single-full-slug scalar reads and presentation-only scales; no gauge discovery route.
- Shared CSV neutralization for malicious formula prefixes and ordinary numeric/text cells.
- Source-level absence of record/set-value/permission mutation calls and arbitrary `_mode` model aggregation controls.

### Browser verification

- Metrics viewer: explorer visible, permissions editor hidden unless separately granted, accessible account history/KPIs readable, inaccessible account denied without fallback.
- System metrics operator: global/public/group/user/custom explicit sources, category and full-slug selection, range/granularity/type/stats/data controls.
- Colon fixtures: `auth:failures`, `foo:count`, and `bar:count` remain separately labeled with correct values.
- Fan-out: sum and one-slug breakdown, duplicate child labels retain `#id`, invalid/missing child kind is actionable.
- Account/category/slug search and paging never show unauthorized fixtures.
- Exact scalar: raw string/number and optional display scale, no browse claim or fabricated health badge.
- Loading/empty/error/retry states, keyboard flow, narrow layout, light/dark themes, and clean console.

## Challenge

- **Amended — exact dependency:** #1438 lands first; canonical route is `/api/metrics/discover?resource=accounts|categories|slugs` with total `count`, `page_count`, and `next_start`, consumed via typed `mojoCall`.
- **Amended — gauges:** universal gauge browsing is deferred because current encoding is non-injective and lacks a maintained index; exact scalar entry remains presentation-only.
- **Amended — permissions:** Monitoring section uses the route-audience union, every route keeps its exact clause, and Group/User pickers require independent directory grants with request suppression.
- **Amended — identity/chart boundary:** `MetricsChart` gains typed optional `loadSeries`; the explorer injects request-derived full-slug identity and preserves order across collision-split calls.
- **Amended — CSV/mock/cache:** shared CSV cells neutralize formula prefixes; mocks reproduce live tail-key loss and exact discovery; denied/failed requests cannot seed or cross-reuse success cache.
- **Amended — integration:** root owns shared registries and runs every affected verifier plus navigation/typecheck/builds/diff check after aggregate merge.
- **Rebutted — no-oracle authority:** frontend gates remain navigation only; backend account policy filters every discovery/fetch and hidden candidates never influence counts.
- **Rebutted — aggregation registry:** arbitrary `_mode` endpoints/fields stay out of this feature.
